This is the name of the station that will determine the ActiveEvent. When an event is selected prior to processing catch, that event ID will be written to ActiveEvent. Other stations will use that event number as a hint when starting up.
When set to True, CLAMS will not allow the active event to be changed when any workstations are open.
Version of SCS software. This is used to determine the method used to connect to SCS.

If True, CLAMS will check for the "Previous_Occurrence" species_data attribute when adding species to the catch and alert the user if a new species is encountered. It will add/update this attribute if the user adds the species. If False, CLAMS does not check if you have seen this species before or not.

If set to True, a workstation can open a new event before the previous event has closed out. This should be used with care since it is easy to load data into the wrong event when you allow multiple events to be worked on at once.
